backup.intro: Both backup and restore target the RIME user directory (schema configuration, custom patches, user dictionaries).

backup.restoreDesc: Files with the same name will be overwritten; a safety backup is created automatically in the backup's folder before restoring, and a redeploy runs automatically when finished

schemas.reinstallTip: Reinstall: download again and overwrite the user directory (this is an upgrade), then redeploy automatically when finished

apps.introHint: Apps on the list switch automatically to the state configured on the right when input starts—terminal, SSH and console editor apps that take raw English input benefit most.
apps.emptyDesc: Terminals, SSH and remote desktop apps usually take direct English input—set them to “Default English” and they switch automatically when input starts, no need to press Shift every time.
